observations: Multiple used car engines and gearboxes are shown in a pile.
Some components are wrapped in clear plastic film.
The engines appear to be in a workshop or storage environment.
No brand names, model numbers, or part numbers are legible on any of the units.

claims.claim: Toyota Corolla 2010 engine and gear box 2ZR
claims.evidence: No photo shows this clearly enough to read.

claims.claim: Tokunbo, direct from Belgium. Tested and working, no knock, low mileage, never opened.
claims.evidence: No photo shows this; it is the seller's word only.

risks.risk: The engines may not be Toyota Corolla 2ZR or may be different models.
risks.proof: A clear photo of the engine block or the engine identification plate.

risks.risk: The gearboxes may be different models or may be damaged.
risks.proof: A photo of the gearbox casing and the model identification plate.

risks.risk: Internal mechanical condition (e.g., seized, cracked, or worn bearings) is unknown.
risks.proof: A video showing the engine being turned over or a photo of the internal components.

risks.risk: The mileage may be significantly higher than claimed.
risks.proof: A photo of the odometer or the engine hour meter.

proof_requests: Close-up of any label, sticker or metal plate showing the brand and model.
Photo of the engine identification plate (engine code) on the engine block.
Photo of the gearbox identification plate (gearbox code).
Photo of the engine and gearbox with the plastic wrapping removed.
Video of the engine being turned over to check for smooth operation.
response.reason: What the item is shows, but not the model that sets its price: no photo shows it clearly enough to read. The shot asked for first would settle it.
